resources.string: Welcome to Oriedita!
Quick start: select a tool and start drawing lines
Choose a tool from the toolbar to begin working
Line tool: double-click to create a line between points
Circle tool: specify center and radius to create a circle
Select tool: click on an element to select it
Delete tool: removes selected elements
Mountain fold: line that will be folded outward (convex)
Valley fold: line that will be folded inward (concave)
Edge line: defines the boundaries of the origami model
Auxiliary line: helps in construction but is not a fold
Parallel lines: creates a line parallel to existing one
Perpendicular lines: creates a line perpendicular to existing one
Angle bisector: divides an angle in half
Square bisector: divides a square diagonally
Check 1: verifies basic folding conditions
Check 2: verifies geometric constraints
Check 3: verifies topological conditions
Check 4: verifies flat foldability
Zooming: use gestures or +/- buttons to change scale
Panning: hold and drag to move around the canvas
Rotation: use gestures to rotate the model
Saving: save your work in ORH, DXF, or FOLD format
Loading: open an existing file to continue working
Export: export the model to various formats
